description: Check the ARRANGEMENT around each coding sequence, which is what decides whether a finished clone expresses at all: a promoter for the named host within reach on the same strand, a Shine-Dalgarno at a workable spacing (bacteria) or a Kozak context (eukaryote), every tag in the CDS's own reading frame, and a terminator or polyA signal downstream. Paste an annotated GenBank record and the CDS features are used; paste bare sequence and the long ORFs are found instead. Nothing here predicts a LEVEL — it reports what is present, absent or out of frame, and every absence names the signature library it was decided against rather than claiming the construct has none.

circular.description: Treat the construct as circular when annotating it.

host.description: Which host the cassette is for. `auto` infers it from the elements actually found (a CMV/polyA plasmid reads as mammalian, a T7/lac one as bacterial) and says in the result that it did.

sequence.description: The construct: a GenBank record (its CDS, promoter, terminator and tag features are used) or bare DNA.

name: expression_cassette_check
title: Will this construct express?
